errors.description: Model incorrectly inferred the structure was incomplete and required color-matching, ignoring the explicit instruction to identify the shape of the *missing cubes* based on removal from a full 3x3x3 grid. The ground truth confirms 12 cubes were removed from a full structure, making the task purely geometric, not color-based.

Instead of reconstructing the shape of the 12 removed cubes from a full 3x3x3 grid (as correctly reasoned in the ground truth), it treated the structure as an incomplete, color-coded puzzle. This led it to prioritize color alignment over geometric completeness, resulting in selection of Option D instead of the correct Option A.
